title: Canonical integral uniformizer quotient coefficient maps
statement: For a prime $\ell$ and finite $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, use the valuation ring and chosen uniformizer of [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and the continuous integral condensed ring of [det-prop-sfb-qlbar-colimit-x-integral-limit]. Define $S_n$ by the existing discrete continuous-map condensed ring [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring], at exponent $n+1$. Define $R\to S_n$ and $S_n\to S_m$ by postcomposition by the actual quotient and quotient-factor maps [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring-map]. Pull these maps to each small pro-etale site [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. Define multiplication by $\pi^{n+1}$ on the regular internal module and its cone, together with the actual quotient projection into the restricted regular quotient module.
